metadata.description: Agent coding skills by Marek Kawalski

plugins.name: better-code-review
plugins.description: Requirement-driven code review for a finished branch, pull or merge requests, or a whole ticket: it maps what the change affects beyond its diff and keeps a serious finding only if an independent challenger fails to disprove it.

plugins.name: better-grilling
plugins.description: Interviews you about a plan or design one question at a time, in a fixed card format that explains each concept, draws a diagram where it helps, and recommends an answer.

plugins.name: help-me-understand
plugins.description: Tells you what something does and how it does it (code, a script, a pull or merge request, a ticket, a coding concept, or anything else) in plain words and in your language, in a fixed card with a diagram, and saves the explanation for reuse.
